subject.title: fix(anthropic): restrict OAuth callback host to loopback addresses and derive redirect URI

question: Should this PR land the loopback-only Anthropic OAuth callback-host rule and derived redirect URI despite breaking non-loopback OPENCLAW_OAUTH_CALLBACK_HOST values?
rationale: The code repair is narrow and well-proven, but it changes a shipped auth env/default behavior and depends on maintainer acceptance of a defense-in-depth security framing under the documented trusted-operator model.

options.title: Accept Loopback-Only Anthropic OAuth
options.body: Approve the fail-closed callback-host validation because arbitrary remote callback hosts are not a supported local CLI auth shape and the implementation follows the existing OpenAI OAuth pattern.

options.title: Require Live Provider Exchange Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted live Anthropic token-exchange proof before accepting provider-side redirect registration risk for every allowed loopback spelling.

options.title: Pause For OAuth Direction
options.body: Pause or close the PR if maintainers prefer deprecating or replacing the direct Anthropic OAuth helper instead of hardening it in place.

recommendation.title: Accept Loopback-Only Anthropic OAuth
recommendation.body: Approve the fail-closed callback-host validation because arbitrary remote callback hosts are not a supported local CLI auth shape and the implementation follows the existing OpenAI OAuth pattern.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and therefore the clearest owner for the remaining merge-risk/security acceptance decision.
